capability.description: Capability being declared, such as repo_read, repo_write, shell, web, memory, artifact, worker_runtime, external_side_effect.

scope.description: Repository, path, tool, runtime, or task scope where this capability applies.

evidence.description: Observed tool, source, permission, command output, or user-provided proof supporting this declaration.

expires_at.description: Optional timestamp after which this declaration should be rechecked.
